name: auction catalog
content_styles: Write like a high-end auction catalog about the topic. Each section is a 'lot' with a title, a description, an estimate, and a provenance. Voice is refined, breathless, and absurdly precious about nonsense.
Write like a storage-unit auction listing. Each section is a 'lot' with a description, a starting bid, and a 'buyer beware' note. Voice is fast-talking and slightly shady.
Write like an estate sale catalog. Each section is an item with a description, a price, and a 'sold as-is' note. Voice is matter-of-fact and slightly sad.
layouts: Build an auction catalog: a header, then numbered 'lot' sections each with a title, an image slot, a description, an estimate, and a provenance. One continuous catalog.
Build a storage auction: a header, then lot cards with descriptions, starting bids, and 'buyer beware' notes. One continuous listing.
Build an estate sale: a header, then item sections with descriptions, prices, and 'sold as-is' notes. One continuous catalog.
themes: Auction look: cream background, black serif text, gold accents, lot numbers, and a refined feel. Unified and elegant.
Storage auction look: white background, bold text, red 'starting bid' accents, and a fast sans-serif. Unified and fast-talking.
Estate sale look: muted background, small text, price tags, and a slightly worn feel. Unified and nostalgic.
